concerns.text: FR-001(c) in spec.md mandates excluding features with |r| > 0.85 correlation to the target. T015 and T018 explicitly implement the opposite ('DO NOT remove any features regardless of correlation strength'). While plan.md overrides this, the tasks lack a clear `[FR-001]` tag or explicit reference to the plan override, creating a traceability gap where the spec requirement appears unmet by the tasks.

FR-007 and plan.md FR-007 require VIF calculation for 'diagnostic clustering only' with NO feature removal. T031 implements this correctly. However, T034a states it will 'apply unsupervised clustering algorithms' to compute Jaccard similarity, which contradicts the plan's specific instruction to use the VIF-based groups from T031. This introduces a new, untagged method not present in the spec or plan, leaving the SC-003 stability check unverified by the defined method.

SC-003 requires measuring Jaccard similarity of 'top 10 SHAP features' (spec) or 'top 10 feature clusters' (plan). T034a mentions 'top feature clusters' but T035 checks 'Jaccard ≥ 0.7' without specifying if the check applies to the top 10 clusters or all clusters. The task description lacks the specific 'top 10' constraint found in SC-003, risking an incomplete verification of the success criterion.

T043 ('Run quickstart.md validation') and T044 ('Final verification of computational constraints') are marked as unchecked `[ ]`. These tasks are critical for validating the plan's constraints (SC-004) and the quickstart guide. Their absence as completed tasks means the plan's success criteria regarding runtime/memory and quickstart validity are not covered by a completed task.

T033a and T034a reference 'SHAP-only resampling' and 'top feature clusters' but lack explicit `[SC-003]` or `[FR-005]` tags. While the description matches the plan, the lack of explicit traceability tags makes it difficult to verify coverage against the specific success criteria in an automated audit.
